body.objective: Add validated matrix Taylor models with one shared normalized parameter, exact rational coefficients through configurable degree at least two, and an outward interval remainder, so long Grassmann/Mobius transports retain cross-frequency correlation beyond the first-order ivaffine rail.
body.stop_condition: Provide a native/C-equivalent mathlib surface for a matrix family A(e)=sum_{k=0}^N A_k e^k+R(e), e in [-1,1], N>=2, with exact rational coefficient matrices and an outward interval remainder. Required operations are construction, hull/evaluation on a closed subcell, restriction/recentering, transpose, row/column selection, block assembly, add/subtract, checked multiplication retaining all coefficients through degree N and enclosing every omitted and remainder cross term, left and right rectangular solves with exact coefficient recursion plus interval/Krawczyk residual certification, and uniform full-column-rank certification on a finite closed cover. Rebase must preserve the single generator and return an explicit enclosure of every dropped coefficient. Serialization must be deterministic and expose generator, degree, exact coefficients, remainder and refusal code. Validate the API on the committed Phase-3 axial q0 sentinel: 23 radial shells, 256 panels per shell, all 20 complex Grassmann charts, exact rational right-action covariance, separate amplitude transport and the child frequency cell [1/2,2049/4096]. The benchmark must either certify transport beyond the present shell-2 amplitude-rank shortfall or return a typed honest shortfall without weakening rank, covariance or chart gates.
body.current_gate: validated horizon-to-r=4 subspace and amplitude transport after first-order shared-affine correlation loses rank certification
body.forbid: no independent interval box per frequency sample; no point-frequency promotion; no conversion of e^2 or higher shared terms to an interval before the declared truncation boundary; no omitted coefficient or remainder cross term; no unsafe inverse substituted for a checked rectangular solve; no silent generator change; no rank claim from center rank or samples; no global connection, scattering, flux, stability, ghost, positivity, CPT or unitarity claim
body.resource_hint: The present ivaffine surface retains only A0+A1 e and folds A1 B1 e^2 into an interval remainder at every multiplication. On the exact q0 child cell and fixed 256-panel radial cover, the 12x6 regular plane remains graph-chart controlled through shell 2, but the separately propagated 6x6 amplitude loses certified full rank at the shell boundary. A second-order shared model should retain the dominant correlation. Reuse QMat, IvMat, ivm_solve_certified and the checked rectangular-solve design in lib/math/ivaffine.forge; a generic degree-N implementation is preferable to a Phase-3-specific type.
notes: For degree two, multiplication must keep C0=A0B0, C1=A0B1+A1B0 and C2=A0B2+A1B1+A2B0 exactly, and enclose the e^3/e^4 terms plus all interactions with R.
For A(e)X(e)=B(e), solve A0X0=B0, A0X1=B1-A1X0 and A0X2=B2-A1X1-A2X0 exactly, then certify the remaining correction against the full interval hull.

Required mutations: drop A1B1 from C2; drop an e^3 or remainder cross term; solve on the wrong side; flatten the shared parameter to an interval; change the generator; perform an unsafe recenter; infer rank from center rank; and serialize coefficients in nondeterministic order.
This request is a reusable mathlib capability, not permission to encode the Schwarzschild equations in mathlib.
